criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: Implement GET /api/products/ using ProductSerializer(many=True). Demonstrate populated and empty results, documenting whether pagination is enabled. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement POST using request.data, serializer validation and save. A valid product returns 201; invalid stock returns 400 and no extra row. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement GET detail using a primary-key URL parameter. Return serialized data for an existing row and 404 for a missing one. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement PUT or PATCH with the documented completeness rules. Demonstrate changing stock, preserving unrelated fields on PATCH, and rejecting a negative value. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Implement DELETE returning 204 with an empty body. Verify the row is gone and a subsequent detail request is 404. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Send an unsupported method and malformed JSON using local API tests. Record 405 and 400 behaviour and prove the database remains unchanged. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Reimplement list/create with a DRF generic view in a separate module. Compare the serializer, queryset and permission configuration while retaining the same observable contract. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
